task.description: Implement OIDC-07 claim validation according to src/design/oidc-07-claim-validation.md. Required checks in verification path: signature validity using cached JWKS integration from OIDC-06, iss matches tenant-configured issuer, aud includes tenant/client configured audience, exp in future with configurable symmetric clock skew (default 30s), nbf in past or absent with same skew handling. Failures must reject with HTTP 401 and structured auth error mapping. Add/update unit and integration tests that individually cover wrong issuer, wrong audience, expired token, not-yet-valid token, and bad signature.
acceptance_criteria: OIDC-07 invalid-case matrix covered by tests with each case returning HTTP 401

result.summary: Implemented OIDC-07 claim-validation behavior with explicit 401 auth machine-code mapping for issuer/audience/expired/not-yet-valid/signature failures, configurable keycloak clock skew defaulting to 30s, and unit/integration coverage for the invalid-case matrix.
